output.title: Which plans include a nurse callback
output.draft_text:
Question: Which plans include a nurse callback?

Answer: A nurse callback is included with the following plans: [list of plan names that include a nurse callback]. It is not included with [list of plan names that do not include a nurse callback].

What the nurse callback is: [description of the nurse callback service, for example what the nurse can help with].

How a member requests a callback: [how to request a callback, for example phone number, member portal, or advocate referral]. Members can request a callback during [hours of availability and time zone].

What to expect: A nurse will typically call back within [expected callback timeframe]. There is [cost to the member, if any] for this service.

Eligibility notes: [any eligibility conditions, for example plan year, group or employer opt-in, or dependent coverage]. [Any exclusions or limitations, for example the service does not replace emergency care or a primary care visit].

If a member has an emergency, advise them to [emergency instruction, for example call emergency services].

If you are unsure whether a member's plan includes the nurse callback, check [where advocates verify plan benefits] or contact [escalation contact or team].
